personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, clean, and highly functional real estate marketplace bridging clients and owners with absolute clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content, comfortable vertical rhythms. Cards never touch screen edges. Sticky CTAs always have safe-area clearance.

do's: Bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it

screens.name: Auth / Onboarding
screens.purpose: Welcome users and allow them to login/register, selecting their role (Client vs Bailleur).

states.error: Standard alert or inline red text for invalid credentials.

screens.layout: Hero image of Kinshasa landscape at the top with gradient scrim. Logo placed centrally. Segmented control (pill style) to toggle between 'Client' and 'Bailleur'. Standard clean input fields for email/password. 'Secret' admin access via 5 taps on the logo.

screens.name: Client Home Feed
screens.purpose: Browse available real estate listings for rent (Location) and sale (Vente).

states.empty: Illustration of an empty house with text 'Aucune propriété disponible' and a refresh button.

screens.layout: Header with search bar and filter icon. Scrollable list of property cards. Each card fills width (minus padding), featuring a 4:3 image, price in bold, Location/Vente badge (using brandSecondary for Vente, brandPrimary for Location), title, neighborhood, and a row of specs (chambres, superficie) separated by subtle dividers.

screens.name: Search & Filters (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Allow users to refine their property search.
screens.layout: Bottom-sheet modal covering 75% of the screen. Glass header with drag handle. Sections for 'Type' (Location/Vente chips), 'Prix' (range slider), 'Quartier' (dropdown/chips), 'Chambres' (segmented control). Sticky 'Appliquer' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Property Details
screens.purpose: Showcase a single property and capture lead interest.

states.error: Error fetching details with retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image carousel at top. Content area overlaps image slightly with top-rounded corners. High-contrast price, address, and key stats (beds, baths, sqft). Amenities listed as chips in brandTertiary. Sticky CTA at the bottom: 'Je suis intéressé' in brandPrimary. This button notifies the admin without direct messaging.

screens.name: Favorites

states.empty: Heart icon illustration with 'Vous n'avez pas encore de favoris'.

screens.layout: Simple 1-column list of saved property cards. Similar to Home Feed but optimized for quick scanning.

screens.name: Owner (Bailleur) Portal
screens.purpose: Dashboard for property owners to add and manage their listings.

states.empty: Illustration with 'Ajoutez votre première propriété' CTA.

screens.layout: Top metric cards (Active Listings, Pending). List of 'Mes Propriétés' with status badges (En ligne, En attente). Floating Action Button (FAB) to 'Ajouter une propriété' (+ icon). Multi-step form for adding a listing.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard (Hidden)
screens.purpose: Platform management: users, listings approval, interest tracking, and commission calculation.
screens.layout: Data-heavy utility layout. Tabs for 'Propriétés', 'Utilisateurs', 'Intérêts' (leads to connect), and 'Finances' (payments, tracking 1-month rent for locations, 10% for sales). Actionable list rows to approve properties or connect clients with bailleurs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design Language: Maintain a strict 'iOS-Native Clean' approach. Use the requested White and Blue palette (brandPrimary: #0A4D68) consistently to project trust and professionalism for real estate.
Property Details Screen: Implement a full-bleed hero image carousel. Ensure the 'Je suis intéressé' button is sticky at the bottom with safe-area clearance, triggering an admin notification.
Image Treatment: All text layered on property images (e.g., in carousels or cards) MUST have a gradient scrim underneath (transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse) for readability.

Navigation & Flow: Implement 3 distinct portals. Use a segmented control on the Auth screen to toggle between Client and Bailleur. Implement a hidden gesture (5 rapid taps on the app logo) on the Auth/Home screen to access the Admin portal.
Admin Business Logic: The admin dashboard must include tracking for the specific commission structures: 1 month of rent equivalent for rentals, and 10% of the sale price for sales.
Filtering: Use a bottom-sheet modal for search filters (Price, Type, Area) to keep context of the map/list in the background.
All app strings and UI elements MUST be in French, tailored to the Kinshasa market context.
